note: Primary-source facts that no XBRL or prose extractor can reach. WhiteHawk has filed no 10-K or 10-Q since the 2026-06-10 IPO, so sec_companyfacts.json carries only S-1 fee-table (ffd) concepts and filing_facts carries a single regex-parsed figure. Every row below is read off a table in the 424B4 prospectus and is held to the same source/locator/as-of bar as an extracted fact.

facts.rationale: Class B common carries votes and no economic rights, so it is not a claim on value. The Continuing Equity Owners' 3,750,000 OpCo Interests are exchangeable 1:1 into Class A and are the real 14.0% economic claim. The earnout is 25% of the $130.0m Internalization Price payable in OpCo Interests; at the $26.00 IPO price that is 1,250,000 units, diluting the Company to 82.1%.

source.locator: Our Organizational Structure; the Company will own 22,996,579 OpCo Interests (86.0%) and the Continuing Equity Owners 3,750,000 (14.0%)

facts.rationale: Pro forma Cash Available for Distribution for FY2025. CAFD is struck after cash interest expense, cash taxes and cash preferred dividends, so it is already an equity-level cash flow; net debt and the mezzanine preferred must not be subtracted from a CAFD-derived value a second time.

source.locator: Reconciliation of Cash Available for Distribution, Pro Forma Year Ended December 31, 2025: $36,317 thousand

facts.rationale: Total estimated net proved reserves at 2025-12-31 in MMcfe (177,380 MMcf gas + 3,457 MBbl NGL + 1,392 MBbl oil at 6:1). Of this, 178,544 MMcfe is proved developed producing, 23,066 MMcfe proved developed non-producing and 4,864 MMcfe proved undeveloped. Reserve report prepared by CG&A.

source.locator: SUMMARY RESERVE DATA, WhiteHawk column at December 31, 2025, Estimated proved reserves Total (MMcfe): 206,473

facts.rationale: PV-10 of $293.690m divided by 206,473 MMcfe of total proved reserves = $1.422 per Mcfe. PV-10 is the pre-tax standardized measure discounted at 10% under SEC rules, using trailing-12-month average prices of $3.387/MMBtu Henry Hub and $65.34/bbl WTI, realized at $3.03/Mcf gas, $22.03/bbl NGL and $62.99/bbl oil.

source.locator: SUMMARY RESERVE DATA, WhiteHawk column at December 31, 2025, PV-10: $293,690 thousand against 206,473 MMcfe

facts.rationale: Pro forma total debt of $75.000m less pro forma cash of $10.537m gives net debt of $64.463m, plus the $30.643m Series B preferred carried in mezzanine equity and senior to Class A. Series D was fully redeemed with IPO proceeds and is zero as-adjusted. These claims are serviced inside CAFD (cash interest and cash preferred dividends), so a CAFD-derived component must not deduct them again.

source.locator: Capitalization table as-adjusted: total debt $75.0m, cash $10.537m, Series B Preferred 42,038 shares / $30.643m mezzanine

facts.rationale: PV-10 of $293.690m less the standardized measure of discounted future net cash flows of $266.326m. The difference is the SEC-computed present value of future income taxes on the proved reserves, i.e. a 9.32% tax drag on reserve value.

source.locator: SUMMARY RESERVE DATA, WhiteHawk column at December 31, 2025: Standardized Measure $266,326 thousand vs PV-10 $293,690 thousand

facts.rationale: Class A common shares outstanding after the Transactions, held one-for-one against the Company's OpCo Interests. Class B (3,750,000) carries no economic rights and is excluded.

source.locator: Dilution: 15,296,579 Class A outstanding before the offering plus 7,700,000 offered = 22,996,579

facts.rationale: Corrects a sign error. The extracted ledger carried net_income_m = +32.0 from an otc_prose regex over the S-1/A at medium confidence. Pro forma FY2025 net income is a LOSS of $32.330m; historical FY2025 as restated is a loss of $3.585m. Pro forma depletion, depreciation and accretion of $36.451m is essentially equal to pro forma CAFD of $36.317m, which is why a company generating $36m of CAFD still reports a loss.

source.locator: Reconciliation of Adjusted EBITDA, Net income (loss), Pro Forma Year Ended December 31, 2025: $(32,330) thousand
